decision.title: Packets start when their dependencies are committed (amends )

body.p: by the orchestrator, toward the owner's goal of working XQuery and XSLT. A packet of a later phase may start as soon as every packet in its "After" list is committed, whether or not it is marked "Early". The phase gates still close each phase: a phase is done only when its gate review passes, and gate reviews re-check the work of later-phase packets that started early. First applied to 3.8, 3.10 and 3.13.
